description: Collect your iOS and Android application logs and send them to Bugfender for remote access. Now with .NET 10 and .NET 9 support, network logging, and Bugfender SDK 4.0.1/3.0.1.
releaseNotes: v6.0.0: Network logging (capture, filters, obfuscation handlers). Android SDK 4.0.1 + android-okhttp; iOS SDK 3.0.1.
title: Bugfender SDK for .NET MAUI
